_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/email-signatures.json (or $CC_MS365_SIGNATURES). One entry per sending identity. ms365-compose-body.py REFUSES an unknown id rather than inventing a name, title or phone — if a field is unknown, ask the operator, do not guess. Omit a key entirely rather than writing a placeholder into it. Optional 'font'/'size' override the house default per identity: a consumer Outlook.com mailbox composes in Calibri 12pt (measured), an M365 mailbox composes in Aptos.

chris-reso.name: Chris Ren
chris-reso._note: No title and no phone: nobody has supplied them. Add them rather than letting the tool guess — it will not.
